mission: Resolve Evaluation Methodology V2 conclusively via two independent scientific questions: (1) can V2 distinguish the specific semantic claim from a sibling/sub-provision sharing vocabulary/family? (2) is the detailed 12-state taxonomy itself reproducible between independent blinded human-equivalent adjudicators at >=85%? This is the FINAL planned evaluator methodology phase - no automatic Phase 3F.1.5.4.
